blurb: Forgotten Coast Brewing Co. is the local beer made by beer lovers who love living here. We have a smooth and distinctive character that evokes the land we love. It’s the flavor of Old Florida that pairs well with fresh Gulf shrimp or a perfectly grilled cheeseburger.
